messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool eu-west-1:pool-42 capacity_exhaustion detected. queue_length=1220, avg_latency=3.4s, autoscaler_status=FAILED_TO_SCALE, desired=8, actual=4. Paging on-call.
alice (eng-oncall): got the page, i'm on it. starting triage — pulling autoscaler logs and pool metrics.
pagerduty-bot: Assigned to alice (eng-oncall). Escalation level: Page -> SRE team.
alice (eng-oncall): @david can you take autoscaler logs? looks like reconcile loop hit scale limit, getting rate-limited by provider qps.
david (infra): on it. grabbing the reconciler logs now. suspect provider 429s during create_node calls. running: `kubectl logs -n infra autoscaler-0 --since=15m`
ben (sre): i'm checking request queue heatmap + routing. if we can't add nodes fast, need to divert low-priority traffic or enable burst fallback to eu-central.
carmen (support): getting customer impact list from support dashboard. initial look: 18 orgs showing elevated 429s, some chat sessions timed out. I'll notify CS and send a customer status note.
alice (eng-oncall): logs show repeated create failures: `403` then `429` then `error: quotaExceeded`. provider message: "Temporary quota limit reached for GPUs in eu-west-1". autoscaler kept retrying until hitting internal backoff threshold.
david (infra): confirmed. Provider quota is exhausted in eu-west-1 for this account. Autoscaler didn't fail open; it saturated and then stopped reconciling new requests. Patch idea: add a short-circuit fallback to region routing when autoscaler cannot fulfill for >2m.
ben (sre): quick mitigation: can we temporarily route new inference traffic to eu-central and us-west pools? I can flip routing weight to send 40% to eu-central.
alice (eng-oncall): do it. make sure to mark model variants as compatible. ben, also set a short-lived rate-limit for non-premium customers to reduce queue growth.
ben (sre): applying route change now: `infractl route update --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central --weight 40% --models "*"` -> done. observed inbound queue dropping steadily.
eve (product): timeline note for postmortem: start time 3641234567. Customers reported degraded responses beginning ~3641234575. please capture exact counts for the postmortem.
carmen (support): status update for customers: posting to status.redwood.com now. message: "We have partial degradation in EU region; mitigation in progress. If you're affected, reach out to support." :loudspeaker:
alice (eng-oncall): manual scale attempt still failing due to provider quota. provider support ticket opened — case #EU-78910.
david (infra): provider responded: capacity freeing ETA ~15-20m. suggested workaround: move some reserved capacity from staging into prod if possible. spinning up a small reserved pool in eu-central instead.
ben (sre): good. queue dropped from 1220 -> 420 in 7m after routing change and temporary throttles. still some in-flight jobs will take ~10m to drain.
carmen (support): customers impacted count: flagged 22 orgs on internal list (some duplicates across teams). I've tagged enterprise customers and pinged AMs for high-touch comms.
alice (eng-oncall): can we confirm downstream APIs returning 429/503 counts? telemetry shows 429 spike to 1.8k/min during peak, now falling back to 120/min.
david (infra): autoscaler reconciler logs: `reconcile loop: create_node failed -> provider: quotaExceeded; backoff exponent=6, giving up`. we'll add a guard to surface quotaExceeded as a soft-failure and trigger routing fallback earlier.
ben (sre): actioned temporary config: `defaults.throttle.non_premium=0.6` (60% of baseline). also increased healthcheck grace period to avoid flapping.
eve (product): thanks — for postmortem include customer impact summary, timeline, mitigation steps, and proposed fixes (autoscaler change, routing policy, alert thresholds).
alice (eng-oncall): incident status: mitigated — core queue draining, no new create attempts failing after routing change. keeping thread open for next 30m to monitor.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by alice (eng-oncall). Status set to "Mitigated".
ben (sre): immediate follow-ups: (1) implement autoscaler early-fallback to multi-region routing on quota errors; (2) add alert if provider 429 rate > 50/min for >3m; (3) runbook update to include manual route flip procedure.
david (infra): dev task created: infra#1321 "Autoscaler: treat provider quotaExceeded as routing trigger". I'll own the PR and testing.
alice (eng-oncall): post-incident on-call action: write a short playbook entry. I'll draft and @ben can review.
carmen (support): I'll prepare the customer-facing timeline and send to comms for approval. backlog of support tickets created: 28, prioritizing enterprise ones.en (sre): retrospective note: we should add capacity probing to detect provider soft limits before hitting production scale attempts. suggestion: periodic low-traffic allocation test.
eve (product): agree, and add this into the roadmap for Q2 reliability work.
alice (eng-oncall): last check: queues at 40, avg latency 200ms, no new 429s. marking last message timestamp 3641234678. thanks everyone, great coordination. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED (mitigated). Summary: GPU quota exhaustion in eu-west-1 caused autoscaler to stop scaling; mitigation: multi-region routing, customer throttling, provider ticket; follow-ups assigned to infra#1321, runbook update, alert tuning."
